This class manages tab selection, the active state, and sets CSS classes (such as 'classActive') that define the visual state of each tab. To address the contrast issue, it would be necessary to update the CSS classes or logic that handle the visual differentiation of selected and unselected tabs. No other classes or functions in the provided skeleton directly relate to rendering or styling the tabs. 1.bug_scenario: The bug scenario is a visual accessibility issue with the Content Switcher component. According to the report and scenario images, the unselected tab(s) have a light grey outline or background that fails to meet the WCAG 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast minimum of 3:1 against the background. This insufficient contrast makes it difficult for users, especially those with low vision, to identify the component's structure and understand which tab is selected, particularly in a 2-tab scenario where the unselected tab may not look like an interactive part of the switcher. The report and images suggest that adding a higher-contrast outline or border to the unselected tabs would resolve the issue.
